claims.claim: GracefulShutdown waits for SIGTERM or SIGINT then calls Shutdown with the timeout, and returns afterward
WithShutdownManager makes Open and OpenDuplex register the conversation, and Close deregisters it
After Shutdown, Register returns ErrShutdownManagerClosed and Open closes the conversation and returns an error wrapping it
Shutdown closes at most 100 conversations at a time, returns the ctx error on deadline, otherwise joins Close errors with errors.Join
Register accepts any io.Closer; Deregister is safe for unknown IDs; Len returns the tracked count
